_doc: maturation_dispatch.py's settings (item RIMMANDRAKE_WIRE_DISPATCH_TO_LAUNCH_BUILDERS_MODS_SAT_IDLE). The owner, 2026-11-14 ~9 PM PST: "So can we wire up Operations/Dispatch such that they do advance on these offline builders? ... As long as we don't have automated loops rejecting/cycling things, we can't get into too much trouble."
_advancing_doc: The four by his card of 2026-11-14 (spec §5 Dispatch), and Graffiti by his word the same night (it is at the Designer, which is never auto-launched). Order is launch priority when slots are short.
_max_live_doc: At most this many live detached runs on advancing mods at once, the Conductor's own launches included.
_stage_ceiling_doc: Set by the builder of this step: one mod's measured dollars at the offline build (every run the status page places there, plus this step's launches, a run with no measured dollars counted at its cap) past this line stops the step on that mod, with a Needs Conductor line. About four capped runs.
_settle_doc: A run that ended less than this many seconds ago is not judged yet (the tick is 60 s; its published files may not have reached the dispatch clone). Nothing launches on the mod meanwhile.
_ingame_doc: In-game acceptance (item RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_IN_GAME_STAGE_LAUNCHER_PYRELANDS_ARRIVED_FIRST). One live driver (opus, ingame_cap_usd) when visit N is owed (no visit_N folder), nothing is live, just ended or seen as an in-game run on it, no in-game run is live on any mod (one live-game driver at a time), and `rimflow bridge idle` says takeable. At most ingame_auto_runs_per_visit automatic runs per visit; every ended visit is a Needs Conductor line; the program never advances. ingame_enabled ships false by the night order of 2026-11-15: the timer starts no live run until the Conductor has run the first visit by hand (maturation.py launch) and sets it true.
_blind_doc: The blind challenge (item RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_BLIND_CHALLENGE_LAUNCHER_FOUR_MODS_PARKED). One judge (opus, blind_cap_usd: the hand briefs' $20 bound) when cycle N is owed (no cycle_N folder) and nothing is live, just ended (settle_s) or seen as a blind run since the cycle opened. At most blind_auto_cycles_per_visit automatic cycles per visit, by the owner's condition: "As long as we don't have automated loops rejecting/cycling things, we can't get into too much trouble." Every ended cycle is a Needs Conductor line; the program never advances.
